title: Minimum Operations to Make All Grid Elements Equal
summary: Given a 2D integer grid and an integer k, determine the minimum operations needed to make all grid elements equal by selecting and incrementing k x k submatrices.
statement: Given a 2D integer grid and an integer k, determine the minimum operations needed to make all grid elements equal by selecting and incrementing k x k submatrices. If equalization is impossible, return -1.
constraints: grid is nonempty and k does not exceed either dimension.
One operation increments every cell of a chosen k×k submatrix by one.
Return the minimum operations making all cells equal, or -1.
reference_solution:
def minimum_square_increments(grid,k):
    rows=len(grid);columns=len(grid[0]);maximum=max(map(max,grid))
    coefficient=[[0]*(columns+2) for _ in range(rows+2)];constant=[[0]*(columns+2) for _ in range(rows+2)];forced=None
    for i in range(1,rows+1):
        for j in range(1,columns+1):
            coefficient[i][j]+=coefficient[i-1][j]+coefficient[i][j-1]-coefficient[i-1][j-1]
            constant[i][j]+=constant[i-1][j]+constant[i][j-1]-constant[i-1][j-1]
            current_coefficient=coefficient[i][j];current_constant=grid[i-1][j-1]+constant[i][j]
            if i+k-1<=rows and j+k-1<=columns:
                add_coefficient=1-current_coefficient;add_constant=-current_constant
                coefficient[i][j]+=add_coefficient;coefficient[i+k][j]-=add_coefficient;coefficient[i][j+k]-=add_coefficient;coefficient[i+k][j+k]+=add_coefficient
                constant[i][j]+=add_constant;constant[i+k][j]-=add_constant;constant[i][j+k]-=add_constant;constant[i+k][j+k]+=add_constant
            elif current_coefficient==1:
                if current_constant!=0:return -1
            else:
                numerator=-current_constant;denominator=current_coefficient-1
                if numerator%denominator:return -1
                candidate=numerator//denominator
                if forced is not None and forced!=candidate:return -1
                forced=candidate
    target=forced if forced is not None else maximum
    def check(target):
        diff=[[0]*(columns+2) for _ in range(rows+2)];operations=0
        for i in range(1,rows+1):
            for j in range(1,columns+1):
                diff[i][j]+=diff[i-1][j]+diff[i][j-1]-diff[i-1][j-1]
                current=grid[i-1][j-1]+diff[i][j]
                if current>target:return -1
                if current<target:
                    if i+k-1>rows or j+k-1>columns:return -1
                    amount=target-current;operations+=amount;diff[i][j]+=amount
                    diff[i+k][j]-=amount;diff[i][j+k]-=amount;diff[i+k][j+k]+=amount
        return operations
    return check(target) if target>=maximum else -1

hints: Scan symbolically first because every forced increment is an affine function of the final target.
At cells where no new k×k square can start, equality yields a target equation; all such equations must agree.
Run a numeric 2D-difference scan at that forced target, greedily adding the exact deficit at each startable cell.
The symbolic boundary equations find the only feasible target (or show none); the numeric scan is forced at every cell and therefore minimal.
